messages:
Jordan M: Hey product/design folks — new PM here (Jordan). Quick access question: I can't install the Figma plugins we use (Design Linter, Research Notes) and I can't see the Product/Research pages in Notion. Who should I ping to get this unblocked for my first-week research ramp?

Sam - IT: @Jordan M — welcome! For Figma I can add you to the Designers group. Two options: 1) send me your corporate email here, or 2) open the IT self-service portal > Software > Figma and request org access. After I add you the team-managed plugins should install automatically. If you're on a personal laptop, you'll still be able to use the web app at figma.com.

Onboard Bot: Created IT ticket #6782 for Jordan M (Figma org access). Sam assigned.

Maria S: Hey Jordan — I added you to the Product Research group in Notion and shared the Research home page. Notion link: https://redwood.notion.so/Product-Research (you should have view access now). We keep research templates at /Playbooks/Recruiting-and-Interviews and a sprint checklist under /Playbooks/Ramp. If you need edit perms on any child page ping me and I'll grant.

Lily P: Welcome! Also fyi — Design Linter and Research Notes are team-managed plugins; when Sam adds you to Designers you'll see them under 'Plugins > Manage'. If anything fails, DM me and I can manually run installs for you. I can also do a short design system walkthrough tomorrow at 10am.

Alex R: Hi Jordan — happy to pair on the roadmap + research kickoff. Roadmap lives in Notion at /Product/Roadmap-Quarterly-2026. I can invite you with comment-level access by default; request edit if you need to update tickets.

Jordan M: Thanks all! Sam — my email is jordan.m@redwood.work. Maria — appreciate the Notion share. Can someone drop the direct roadmap link in the thread? :bow:

Sam - IT: Added jordan.m@redwood.work to the Figma org and the Designers group. You should receive an invite email; plugins will show up once you sign in. Ticket #6782 resolved.

Onboard Bot: Ticket #6782 marked resolved by Sam - IT. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Jordan M: Got the invite + plugins installed, and I can open Notion now. Thanks everyone — feel much less stuck. :raised_hands:

Lily P: Awesome — I'll add you to the product sync invite and drop a quick 15m intro slot on your calendar for the design system tour. Ping here if anything else pops up.
